description: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited engages in the business of owning, operating and managing hotels, palaces and resorts under TAJ brand in India. The company operates Taj Krishna, Taj Deccan, and Vivanta Begumpet in Hyderabad, as well as Taj Chandigarh in Chandigarh, Taj Santacruz in Mumbai, and Taj Club House in Chennai. It also offers food and beverages services; and banquets and other services. Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited was formerly known as TAJGVK Hotels & Resorts Limited and changed its name to Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited in September 2026. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
